scope: Public sources only. Source review and host validation; not a hardware qualification or binary release.

imports.purpose: SEP xART ownership guard and platform DMA windows
imports.downstream_policy: Opt-in only: xart_guard=1 or 2. Default remains 0 on every SiliconForest platform; no automatic migration of existing Linux records. Cold-boot M1 identity provisioning can require guard=0.
review_fixes: Bound append by physical list capacity, including duplicate and unreadable entries.
Read a bounded prefix of oversized lists and refuse further adoption.
Reserve in-memory capacity before writing and flushing an entry.
Flush the parent directory on every ownership-list open; fail closed if persistence fails.
imports.validation_limit: Allocation failure is not injectable in these KUnit tests; reservation-before-I/O is verified by source review. Write, flush and directory failures are injected.

imports.purpose: J613 CPU thermal zones, measured energy model and die sensor keys
review_requirements: Keep J613-measured power and indexed sensor additions scoped to J613, including 25G83.
Preserve critical thermal protection and the existing conservative GPU ceiling.
hardware_pending: Sensor key availability and plausible readings on both firmware profiles, including resume.
CPU and combined CPU/GPU thermal equilibrium and energy-aware scheduling behavior.

review_requirements: Also address CS42L84, the codec actually referenced by the Apple laptop DTs.
Keep the oscillator selected outside D0 and after a failed PLL lock.
hardware_pending: Headphone playback across suspend/resume and recovery after a PLL timeout.
known_limits: Pre-existing capture-across-suspend clock-state behavior remains unresolved.
ASoC prepare ignores the digital-unmute error; a PLL timeout can leave silence until a later prepare.
No claim of complete audio suspend/resume qualification.
Pre-existing CS42L42 PLL retry uses the final divout.

imports.purpose: Transactional T600x explicit-disabled Type-C route handoff
imports.attribution: Downstream adaptation authored by Chris Kearney, based on Andreas Fernandez; no invented Signed-off-by.
review_fixes: Publish explicitly disabled owner routes and DCP status atomically using a scratch FDT.
Match exact disabled status; preserve absent and all other statuses.
Keep the allocation-free legacy enable path on other chips and continue to later optional controllers after failure.
Propagate reservation allocation failure instead of stale success.
imports.compatibility: Downstream T600x routes retain absent status, preserving existing old-loader dual USB-C behavior. No new T600x loader pairing floor. T8122/J613 readiness and strict T6030 handoff remain unchanged.
hardware_pending: Physical display, hotplug and suspend/resume coverage.

review_fixes: Clamp at allocation because XML drirc values bypass environment range validation.
Test the real GPU poly_heap struct with its uint32 size, plus the real allocation callback.
hardware_pending: Game-specific behavior and GPU workloads; no new FPS result claimed.

reviews.linux: accepted by Claude and Grok at 7560c8b4747f79cf18d8ac90c11f6bec9f4e2eca; no source blockers

linux.thermal_scope_validation: Five non-J613 T8122 decompiled DTBs match the baseline before PR146. Both J613 DTBs match the imported thermal series, including sensor indices 0-5. Existing warnings unchanged.
linux.kunit_reproduction: From the pinned kernel, use tools/testing/kunit/kunit.py run --arch=arm64 --kunitconfig=<saved config> --build_dir=<dedicated output>, with LLVM=1, Rust 1.93.1, the corrected bindgen generator and LIBCLANG_PATH=/usr/lib. Select a kernel-compatible QEMU arm64 environment.
linux.known_harness_dependency: APPLE_SEP currently needs CONFIG_SPI=y even though its existing Kconfig omits the dependency. Saved SEP test config selects SPI and OF_OVERLAY, as the production configuration does.

pairing.kernel_and_dtbs: Build from the same locked revision.
pairing.j613_external_display: Normal display drivers only; exact firmware compatibility 14 7 0 and existing readiness, memory and supplier gates still required. 26.6.2 camera support does not imply external display support.
pairing.m3_production_profile: CONFIG_SILICONFOREST_NATIVE_GPU=y retains normal display and USB4 paths. CONFIG_SILICONFOREST_M3 is a separate alternative profile.

kernel_pin_policy: The lock records reviewed code commit 7560c8b4747f rather than its GitHub merge commit. The merge has an identical tree, and the code commit is on siliconforest/next.
